# Radar chart syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-radar/grammar/radar.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Radar chart syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `radar-beta` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4). mermaid@12 parsed radar with Langium (`radar.langium` and `common.langium` in
`@mermaid-js/parser`); the rules below are its token rules, in its order, and its grammar.

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read
as `='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as
opaque text; and a line break appended. Keywords are case-sensitive.

A word keyword gives way to a longer name (`maxi`, `axisB` and `min-1` are names), but
`circle`, `polygon`, `true`, `false` and `title` do not: `circles` is `circle` and the name
`s`, so no name can start with them (D357). Statements need no separator, except that
`title`, `accTitle` and `accDescr` end their line; `;` is not a separator.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A chart is `radar-beta`, then statements. `title`, `accTitle` and `accDescr` end their line;
the others may share one. The `YAML`, `DIRECTIVE` and `COMMENT` tokens of the lexer are
skipped before parsing.

```ebnf
radar = { NEWLINE } Header { NEWLINE | list | text NEWLINE } [ text ] EOF ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = RADAR_BETA_COLON
               | RADAR_BETA [ COLON ] ;
```

```ebnf
list = AXIS Axis { COMMA Axis }
     | CURVE Curve { COMMA Curve }
     | Option { COMMA Option } ;
```

```ebnf
text = Title
     | AccTitle
     | AccDescr ;
```

`A["Label"]`: an axis, its name and its label (the name when there is none).

```ebnf
Axis @Axis = ID [ LBRACKET STRING RBRACKET ] ;
```

`c["Label"]{1, 2, 3}` or `c{A: 1, B: 2}`: a curve. Its values are all positional, in axis
order, or all `axis: value` pairs (the `:` is optional); line breaks may follow `{` and `,` and
come before `}`.

```ebnf
Curve @Curve = ID [ LBRACKET STRING RBRACKET ] LBRACE entries RBRACE ;
```

```ebnf
entries = { NEWLINE } NumberEntry { COMMA { NEWLINE } NumberEntry } { NEWLINE }
        | { NEWLINE } DetailedEntry { COMMA { NEWLINE } DetailedEntry } { NEWLINE } ;
```

```ebnf
NumberEntry @Entry = NUMBER ;
```

```ebnf
DetailedEntry @Entry = ID [ COLON ] NUMBER ;
```

```ebnf
Option @Option = SHOW_LEGEND BOOLEAN
               | TICKS NUMBER
               | MAX NUMBER
               | MIN NUMBER
               | GRATICULE GRATICULE_VALUE ;
```

`title Skills`: the title drawn at the top (the last one wins).

```ebnf
Title @Title = TITLE ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = ACC_TITLE ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = ACC_DESCR ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | RADAR_BETA_COLON | `radar-beta:` |  | `radar-beta:`: starts a radar chart, as `radar-beta` does. |
| INITIAL | RADAR_BETA | `radar-beta(?:(?=%%)\|(?!\S))` |  | `radar-beta`: starts a radar chart. `radar-beta:` and `radar-beta :` do too. |
| INITIAL | SHOW_LEGEND | `showLegend(?!-*\w)` |  | `showLegend true\|false`: whether the legend lists the curves (default `true`; the last one wins, as for every option). |
| INITIAL | GRATICULE | `graticule(?!-*\w)` |  | `graticule circle\|polygon`: the shape of the rings and of the curves (default `circle`). |
| INITIAL | CURVE | `curve(?!-*\w)` |  | `curve c["Label"]{1, 2, 3}`: a curve, its values in axis order or as `axis: value` pairs. |
| INITIAL | TICKS | `ticks(?!-*\w)` |  | `ticks 5`: the number of rings (default 5, at most 32). |
| INITIAL | AXIS | `axis(?!-*\w)` |  | `axis A["Label"], B`: the axes, in clockwise order from the top. |
| INITIAL | MAX | `max(?!-*\w)` |  | `max 10`: the value at the outer ring (default: the largest value). |
| INITIAL | MIN | `min(?!-*\w)` |  | `min 0`: the value at the centre (default 0). |
| INITIAL | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | LBRACKET | `\[` |  |  |
| INITIAL | RBRACKET | `\]` |  |  |
| INITIAL | LBRACE | `\{` |  |  |
| INITIAL | RBRACE | `\}` |  |  |
| INITIAL | GRATICULE_VALUE | `circle\|polygon` |  | `circle` or `polygon`, the value of `graticule`. |
| INITIAL | BOOLEAN | `true\|false` |  | `true` or `false`, the value of `showLegend`. |
| INITIAL | ACC_DESCR | `[\t ]*accDescr[\t ]*:(?:[^\n\r]*?(?=%%)\|[^\n\r]*)` |  | `accDescr: …` (the rest of the line) or `accDescr { … }` (over lines, to `}`): the accessible description of the chart. mermaid@12's one rule, as two tried in order; the block's `[\s\S]*?\}` is its `[^}]*\}`, written so that line-based highlighters read the block as one span. |
| INITIAL | ACC_DESCR | `[\t ]*accDescr\s*\{[\s\S]*?\}` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ACC_TITLE | `[\t ]*accTitle[\t ]*:(?:[^\n\r]*?(?=%%)\|[^\n\r]*)` |  | `accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the chart, the rest of the line. |
| INITIAL | TITLE | `[\t ]*title(?:[\t ][^\n\r]*?(?=%%)\|[\t ][^\n\r]*\|)` |  | `title …`: the title drawn at the top of the chart, the rest of the line. |
| INITIAL | NUMBER | `[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(?!\.)\|0\|[1-9][0-9]*(?!\.)` |  | A value: a number such as `42` or `3.5`, never negative; no sign, no exponent, no leading zeros and no `.` without digits on both sides. |
| INITIAL | STRING | `"(?:[^"\\]\|\\.)*"\|'(?:[^'\\]\|\\.)*'` |  | A label: `"…"` or `'…'`; `\` escapes the next character, and a label may span lines. |
| INITIAL | ID | `\w(?:[-\w]*\w)?` |  | A name: ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, not ending in `-`. |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `\r?\n` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `[\t ]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | YAML | `---[\t ]*\r?\n(?:[\S\s]*?\r?\n)?---(?:\r?\n\|(?!\S))` |  | A `---` … `---` block inside the body: skipped. |
| INITIAL | DIRECTIVE | `[\t ]*%%\{[\S\s]*?\}%%(?:\r?\n\|(?!\S))` |  | A `%%{…}%%` left in the text the lexer reads: skipped. |
| INITIAL | COMMENT | `[\t ]*%%[^\n\r]*` |  | `%%` to the end of the line, after other text: a comment. |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
